title: DevHarness Research Draft Output
description: Producer output contract for the DevHarness research draft before critic attack or repeat user approval.

outcome.description: Producer must use ready_for_attack for an initial or critic-requested draft and ready_for_approval for a correction requested at the user gate. Missing help is reported through the runner non-blocking stop control channel, never as an output outcome.
outcome.x-usage: Treat this as the authoritative workflow state for this output. Do not infer success from other populated fields when it requires revision.

summary.description: Producer must summarize the research proposal state for human approval without embedding the reasons-canvas-research artifact body.
summary.x-usage: Use this as the human-facing approval state for the research gate. Show it with the artifact attachment; do not recreate the summary from artifact contents in the orchestrator.

artifacts.description: Producer must emit artifact metadata for the required immutable reasons-canvas-research artifact when ready for attack or approval.
artifacts.x-usage: Emit only the required immutable reasons-canvas-research artifact. Exact artifact field semantics come from the shared baton artifact schema.

results.description: Producer may emit compact structured results, decisions, or evidence summaries created by this stage.
results.x-usage: Use these as supporting evidence or compact summaries. Do not let them override outcome, selected steps or approved contracts.
